title: Помесячные ряды для KPI
sql:
WITH first_buy AS (
  SELECT customer_unique_id, min(purchased_at) AS first_at FROM core.orders GROUP BY 1
),
chk AS (
  SELECT order_id, sum(price + freight_value) AS total, sum(price) AS revenue FROM core.order_items GROUP BY 1
),
rv AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (order_id) order_id, score FROM core.order_reviews ORDER BY order_id, created_at DESC, answered_at DESC NULLS LAST
)
SELECT to_char(date_trunc('month', o.purchased_at), 'YYYY-MM') AS month,
       count(*) AS orders_cnt,
       coalesce(sum(c.revenue) FILTER (WHERE o.status = 'delivered'), 0) AS revenue,
       round(avg(c.total) FILTER (WHERE o.status = 'delivered'), 2) AS avg_check,
       count(DISTINCT o.customer_unique_id) AS customers,
       count(DISTINCT o.customer_unique_id) FILTER (WHERE o.purchased_at > f.first_at) AS returned,
       round(100.0 * count(DISTINCT o.customer_unique_id) FILTER (WHERE o.purchased_at > f.first_at) / nullif(count(DISTINCT o.customer_unique_id), 0), 2) AS repeat_pct,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.delivered_at IS NOT NULL) AS delivered,
       round(avg((o.delivered_at::date <= o.estimated_delivery_date)::int) FILTER (WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.delivered_at IS NOT NULL), 4) AS otd,
       round((percentile_cont(.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY extract(epoch FROM o.delivered_at - o.purchased_at) / 86400) FILTER (WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.delivered_at IS NOT NULL))::numeric, 1) AS median_days,
       round(avg(r.score), 2) AS avg_score
FROM core.orders o
JOIN first_buy f USING (customer_unique_id)
LEFT JOIN chk c USING (order_id)
LEFT JOIN rv r USING (order_id)
WHERE o.purchased_at >= '2017-01-01' AND o.purchased_at < '2018-09-01'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

definitions.avg_check: Среднее sum(price + freight_value) по доставленным заказам месяца
definitions.repeat_pct: Доля покупателей месяца, у которых был более ранний заказ

limitations: Исторический снимок Olist, не текущие заказы.
Фильтры start_date/end_date/states применяются к заказам; при фильтре категории/продавца берутся целые заказы.
Повторность считается внутри выбранного среза заказов.

title: Заказы и выручка по дню недели и часу
sql:
SELECT extract(isodow FROM o.purchased_at)::int AS dow,
       extract(hour FROM o.purchased_at)::int AS hour,
       count(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS orders,
       coalesce(sum(i.price) FILTER (WHERE o.status = 'delivered'), 0) AS revenue
FROM core.orders o
LEFT JOIN core.order_items i USING (order_id)
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1, 2
limitations: Исторический снимок Olist, не текущие заказы.
Фильтры start_date/end_date/states применяются к заказам; при фильтре категории/продавца берутся целые заказы.

title: Структура оплат по месяцам
sql:
SELECT to_char(date_trunc('month', o.purchased_at), 'YYYY-MM') AS month,
       coalesce(round(sum(p.amount) FILTER (WHERE p.payment_type = 'credit_card'), 2), 0) AS credit_card,
       coalesce(round(sum(p.amount) FILTER (WHERE p.payment_type = 'boleto'), 2), 0) AS boleto,
       coalesce(round(sum(p.amount) FILTER (WHERE p.payment_type = 'voucher'), 2), 0) AS voucher,
       coalesce(round(sum(p.amount) FILTER (WHERE p.payment_type = 'debit_card'), 2), 0) AS debit_card
FROM core.orders o
JOIN core.order_payments p USING (order_id)
WHERE o.purchased_at >= '2017-01-01' AND o.purchased_at < '2018-09-01'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

definitions.amount: sum(order_payments.amount) по типу оплаты, все статусы

limitations: Исторический снимок Olist, не текущие заказы.
Фильтры start_date/end_date/states применяются к заказам; при фильтре категории/продавца берутся целые заказы.

title: Распределение рассрочки по картам
sql:
SELECT greatest(least(p.installments, 10), 1) AS installments,
       count(DISTINCT p.order_id) AS orders,
       round(sum(p.amount), 2) AS amount
FROM core.order_payments p
JOIN core.orders o USING (order_id)
WHERE p.payment_type = 'credit_card'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

definitions.installments: Частей рассрочки; 10 = 10 и более, 0 приравнен к 1

limitations: Исторический снимок Olist, не текущие заказы.
Фильтры start_date/end_date/states применяются к заказам; при фильтре категории/продавца берутся целые заказы.

title: Выручка и заказы по штатам
sql:
SELECT o.customer_state AS state,
       count(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS orders,
       coalesce(sum(i.price) FILTER (WHERE o.status = 'delivered'), 0) AS revenue
FROM core.orders o
LEFT JOIN core.order_items i USING (order_id)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY revenue DESC
limitations: Исторический снимок Olist, не текущие заказы.
Фильтры start_date/end_date/states применяются к заказам; при фильтре категории/продавца берутся целые заказы.

title: Заказы по статусам
sql:
SELECT o.status, count(*) AS orders
FROM core.orders o
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC
limitations: Исторический снимок Olist, не текущие заказы.
